text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby. Perhaps running on 
that once-in-a-lifetime stage will bring 
her closer to her "friend."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe hadn't given up on running 
in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she lacked the foundation to run 
through such grueling races. Agnes Tachyon 
saw right through it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe collapsed mid-test prepared 
by Agnes Tachyon. They decided to think 
carefully about their future approach.
